discovery.summary: Match an expected public-company name to SEC ticker/CIK identity
discovery.description: Resolve exactly one SEC ticker or CIK and compare the supplied expected company name with the authoritative SEC EDGAR company name after conservative corporate-suffix normalization. Returns match, human_review, or company_not_found. A match is an SEC identity-consistency result only; it is not investment advice and does not establish good standing, ownership, authority, fraud/sanctions/credit status, or legal compliance.
discovery.resource_description: Check whether an expected public-company name matches the authoritative SEC EDGAR company identity resolved from exactly one ticker or CIK. Returns match, human_review, or company_not_found. It is not investment advice and does not establish good standing, ownership, authority, fraud/sanctions/credit status, or legal compliance.

buyer.task: Check whether a supplied expected company name matches the authoritative SEC EDGAR company identity resolved from exactly one ticker or CIK.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independent external settled buyers and repeat demand; never count test responses, discovery visits, or synthetic transactions as sales.

api.input_rule: Provide company plus exactly one of ticker or cik.

sources.authority: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission EDGAR
sources.refresh_policy: Live ticker resolution and company submissions lookup; SEC_USER_AGENT contact identity required

rules: Require an expected company name plus exactly one ticker or CIK, never both.
Compare conservatively normalized expected name with the authoritative SEC-resolved company name.
Never interpret an SEC identity match as legal status, beneficial ownership, fraud clearance or investment advice.
match is only an SEC identity-consistency result
it does not establish investment quality, current good standing, ownership, authority, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance
company_not_found means the queried identifier did not resolve in the checked SEC public data; it is not proof that the business does not exist

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; payment is not settled.

criteria: Exact-head existing product release gates and deterministic/source checks must pass.
Authority-dependent live smokes and required production credentials (including SEC_USER_AGENT) must pass before any approved deployment.
Complete unit economics and genuine independent external-buyer evidence are unavailable; do not authorize commercial release.
